rows.text: moves the arguments down one place (`edx` = `r8d`, `r8` = `r9`) and, when the incoming `edx` is zero, tail-jumps (`00210BE0` + 0x10) with `rcx` = qword `rcx+8`, otherwise tail-jumps (`00210BE0` + 0x19) with `rcx` = qword `rcx+0x10`
returns 0 when `ecx` is -1; otherwise sets bit 31 of `ecx` (`bts`) and tail-jumps (`002DF280` + 0xC) with the other arguments unchanged
